18e22a5cf14b7e4e7d9f7ac1bbdd2bd27e5a8a4b.summary: ESET researchers describe Android/SpyC32.A, a new spyware variant from the APT-C-23 group (also called Two-Tailed Scorpion), used in active campaigns against victims in the Middle East. It was disguised as a bait messaging app named WeMessage, and the report does not know how that app was distributed. The variant adds screen recording and screenshots, recording of WhatsApp calls, and reading of notifications from social media apps such as WhatsApp and Messenger.
